notes.title: Demo Update - Festive Fun for Christmas!
notes.notes:
Big news! The Christmas demo update drops today, and it’s packed with holiday cheer! 🎅✨

We’ve got:
🎁 A festive game board to explore
🎩 Two cute new hats—Santa and Reindeer Antlers
🐧 A penguin mini-game where you collect (or steal 👀) penguin followers!

It’s the perfect way to cozy up and celebrate the holidays with friends or family. Can’t wait for you to try it out! 

~Lunars Team

notes.title: Halloween Update is LIVE!
notes.notes:
[h2]Hello Lunars! [/h2]

[h3]🎃 HALLOWEEN UPDATE IS HERE! 🎃 [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41838134/228d8b21eb5438f064047c8d11dfeb6d089fd73e.png[/img]

We are happy to announce that we are updating the demo version of the game! You will be able to play a NEW Halloween Board Map and check all the new features in the game!

[h3][b]Here are the patch notes:[/b][/h3]

[b]Accessories/Skin Updates[/b]
[list]
[*] Face accessories added
[*] Neck/back accessories added
[*] Skins added
[*] Eye colors added
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41838134/fee501cf2052e7ce8c2fb8450aa8a4c26f305968.png[/img]
[b]Board Updates[/b]
[list]
[*] New board items added - Coin Trap and Item trap
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41838134/05436cb7d16df7ea1b87d2892e539396c06902bc.png[/img]
[b]Lobby Updates[/b]
[list]
[*] Outfits can now be changed in the lobby at the customization station
[/list]
[b]Character Updates[/b]
[list]
[*] High res textures for Lunars
[/list]
[b]Music Updates[/b]
[list]
[*] New music throughout almost all segments of the game
[/list]
[b]Minigames[/b]
[list]
[*] Pick Up Artist - Adjusted jumping and speed penalty
[*] Updated Pipe Dash - Checkpoints and better grip
[*] Bounce battle - Adjusted controls
[/list]
[b]Bug fixes, stability updates, and localization[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41838134/5c360783ac6b37f2f9bb37e343b92881957378bc.png[/img]

[b]Limited Time Halloween Seasonal Access [/b]
[list]
[*] New Halloween seasonal variant of Medieval board
[*] All new character accessories unlocked
[*] Added new never-before-seen minigames
[/list]

We would like to thank you for all of your support and we wish you a happy Halloween!

[i][b]~Lunars Team[/b][/i]

notes.title: New Update 0.754a
notes.notes:
[h2]Hello Lunars! [/h2]

Today we are coming to you with a new update 0.754a! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41838134/4e2829fb3f8acd3edfb8469b2afe9213aa8d3836.png[/img]

[b]Here are the changes:[/b]

[b]NEW FEATURES[/b]
[list]
[*] AUTORECONNNECT has now been added to the game. If the player disconnects from the game it will try to rejoin again even if the match has already started.
[/list]

[b]UPDATES AND CHANGES[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a third shop to the medieval board
[*] Toadstool Stomp added colors for the starting platforms
[*] Toadstool Stomp increased the frequency of combo shrooms
[*] Toadstool Stomp increased the time for respawning slightly
[*] Disconnection text update to give a better explanation for disconnection
[/list]

[b]BUGS FIXES[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed over slider not showing in Kaiju
[*] Fixed wrong name bug in Lobby when characters are switched
[/list]

Thank you for your support and feedback!

Have a great day! 

[i][b]~Lunars Team[/b][/i]

notes.title: Steam Next Fest - Quick patch 0.748a
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello Lunars! [/h1]

We are coming to you with a quick [b]patch 0.748a[/b]. We are adding new sounds on the board and fixing some bugs!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41838134/cde3f849853f06398fc66e71c4abb1d221b171c6.png[/img]

[b]Here is a full patch note:[/b]:eyes: 

[h3]Updates: [/h3]
[list]
[*] Added and updated sounds on board – More to come! 
[/list]

[h3]Bug fixes: [/h3]
[list]
[*] The issue with purchasing the Jade statue and item is used on you 
[*] Wings item used on the player while running 
[*] Reverse used on the player while on a directional spot 
[*] Can’t spectate when time is up 
[*] Jade indicator goes occasionally missing on the map 
[*] Steam sounds playing while on the instructions menu 
[*] Multiple board item fixes and updates. 
[*] AI idling at the start of Spotlight Scramble
[*] Classic mode initial dice roll players start running bug fixed
[/list]

We want to thank you all for your support and feedback! It is helping us a lot to develop the best possible game!

Have a great day!

[i][b]~Lunars Team[/b][/i]
